title: Si4k Search Engine Complete API Specification & Terminal Manual
description: Complete REST & Streaming API documentation for Si4k Search Engine. Covers ZIM file discovery, active categories list, category-isolated search, multi-ZIM scoped search (1 to 4+ ZIMs), per-search candidate limit overrides (candidateLimit/limit), cross-ZIM index mixing, SSE progressive streaming, and terminal curl command examples.

/search.summary: Standard REST Custom Search API (Google/Bing Style)
/search.description: Executes unified priority search across indexed ZIM collections and returns formatted JSON search results with pagination metadata.

q.description: Search query string (e.g. 'quantum computing', 'how to bake bread', 'fever'). Supports inline @zim tags (@wikipedia_en_all) and #category tags (#medicine).

mode.description: Execution search mode: 'local' (offline LAN search) or 'online' (internet fallback).

pageSize.description: Number of search results returned per page (max 100).

candidateLimit.description: Per-ZIM source candidate limit override for this specific request (aliases: 'candidateLimit', 'limit'). E.g., pass candidateLimit=250 for deep search or candidateLimit=25 for ultra-fast light search.

zims.description: Comma-separated list or array of specific ZIM file identifiers to scope search (e.g. 'wikipedia_en_all,wikihow_en_all' or 'devdocs_en_python_2026-06').

categories.description: Comma-separated list or array of domain categories to filter (e.g. 'programming,medicine,linux,guides,repair,cooking,science').

/zims/names.description: Returns lightweight JSON list containing only the unique ZIM file names currently discovered and available on the server.

terminalExamples.title: Get ZIM File Names Array
terminalExamples.description: Returns JSON with total count and array of ZIM file names.

/categories.description: Returns list of all active domain categories along with source counts for each category.

terminalExamples.title: Get All Active Categories & Counts
terminalExamples.description: Returns active categories and total ZIM collections assigned to each.

/search/category/:category.description: Executes search query specifically constrained to a single target domain category (e.g. medicine, linux, programming, repair).

/search/zims.summary: Multi-ZIM Target Search API (1 to 4+ Selected @ ZIMs)
/search/zims.description: Executes search query restricted exclusively to specified 1, 2, 3, 4+ selected ZIM file datasets.

/search/mixed.summary: Multi-ZIM Index Mixing & Inter-Leaved Ranking API
/search/mixed.description: Performs cross-ZIM candidate gathering, scoring, inter-leaving, and mixing across selected ZIM datasets and domain categories.

terminalExamples.title: Execute Mixed Search with candidateLimit Override
terminalExamples.description: Returns mixed search results from iFixit and wikiHow with per-source candidateLimit=200.

/search/stream.summary: Real-Time Server-Sent Events (SSE) Progressive Stream API

terminalExamples.title: Stream Real-Time Search with candidateLimit=150
terminalExamples.description: Streams progressive SSE search results with candidateLimit=150.

clientExamples.curl_bash:
# Search across 4 ZIM files with candidateLimit=200 and format with jq
curl -s "http://localhost:3000/api/search/zims?q=algorithm&zims=wikipedia_en_all,devdocs_en_python,stackoverflow_en_all&candidateLimit=200" | jq '.results[] | {title, source, score}'
clientExamples.python:
import requests

# Multi-ZIM Search with custom per-source candidate limit
res = requests.post('http://localhost:3000/api/search/mixed', json={
    'q': 'repair engine',
    'zims': ['ifixit_en_all', 'wikihow_en_all'],
    'candidateLimit': 250,
    'pageSize': 10
})
print(res.json())
